title: April 2023 Top Product
summary: Find the product with the highest sales in April 2023. This likely requires filtering sales data to that month and ranking products by total sold.
executed_sql_queries: SELECT store_id, store_name, rls_user_id, is_online FROM retail.stores ORDER BY store_id;

WITH april_orders AS (
    SELECT order_id, store_id
    FROM retail.orders
    WHERE order_date >= DATE '2023-04-01'
      AND order_date < DATE '2023-05-01'
), product_sales AS (
    SELECT oi.product_id,
           SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity_sold,
           SUM(oi.total_amount) AS total_revenue,
           COUNT(DISTINCT oi.order_id) AS number_of_orders
    FROM retail.order_items oi
    JOIN april_orders ao
      ON oi.order_id = ao.order_id
     AND oi.store_id = ao.store_id
    GROUP BY oi.product_id
)
SELECT p.product_id,
       p.product_name,
       ps.total_quantity_sold,
       ps.total_revenue,
       ps.number_of_orders,
       RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ps.total_revenue DESC, ps.total_quantity_sold DESC, p.product_id) AS sales_rank
FROM product_sales ps
JOIN retail.products p
  ON p.product_id = ps.product_id
ORDER BY sales_rank, p.product_id
LIMIT 1;
